items.heading: Ceviche Ecuatoriano
details: Key ingredients: shrimp or fish, lime juice, tomato, onion, cilantro
Cook shrimp briefly, or cure raw fish in lime juice.
Combine with diced tomato, onion and cilantro.
Chill the mixture so the flavors meld and the citrus lightly cooks the seafood.
Serve cold with popcorn or plantain chips on the side.

items.heading: Locro de Papa
details: Key ingredients: potatoes, cheese, milk, avocado, achiote
Simmer diced potatoes in broth with achiote until falling apart.
Mash some of the potatoes to thicken the soup.
Stir in milk and cheese until melted and creamy.
Serve topped with a slice of avocado.
